Each round, and therefore each prefix, is a permutation of Fp^3. Distinct legal input messages cannot merge in the entire state.
Only output lane 0 must agree. Full-state equality is a strictly stronger and impossible goal for distinct legal messages.
All 19 nonempty square minors are nonzero; rank 3 and branch number 4. This is a linear-layer statement, not a nonlinear attack lower bound.
In X=(m0+c00)^5,Y=(m1+c01)^5 coordinates, first-round states form an affine plane with p^2 points. Every one-round digest has exactly p messages.

findings.result: Two-round digest is degree 5 in X,Y, not degree 25 in these coordinates; 21 nonzero coefficients. Fixed X and digest gives at most 5 Y roots.
O=[e0; e0 M; e0 M^2] has rank 3. An internal difference can avoid the active S-box for two consecutive partial rounds, but not three.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: What does each row do?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: 64 round cards record ARC/S-box/MDS and the three phases.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: How does every row reach every other?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: 4096 directed cells; 2080 forward cells sampled; 2016 future-to-stored-past cells are noncausal, not inverse impossibility.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: What is independently writable?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: m0,m1 only. Capacity and all constants are fixed; zero fresh per-round message knobs.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: What corresponds to the dense prefix?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: Legal input plane, first four full rounds, then their p^2-point image. No A0/c7/SHA advice family is imported.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: Which local operations are invertible?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: S-box exponent inverse and MDS inverse give unique whole-state round inverse. Projection to digest is not invertible.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: Can differences cancel or toggle?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: Field difference propagates by M times fifth-power differences; zeros at one projection need not mean whole-state cancellation.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: What is a neutral direction?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: Partial S-box-avoiding subspace has dimensions 2,1,0 for 1,2,3 consecutive active-input equalities. Legal reachability separately required.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: Is a local Jacobian kernel enough?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: No. Zero derivative has a nonzero fifth-order finite displacement; 64 native checks included.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: Can one solve instead of sample?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: New coordinates expose a two-round quintic; exact single-S-box quartic roots known. Full legal-generator costs remain open.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: Can constraints become fewer equations?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: Last digest is one field equation, not three state equations. A generic field equation costs about 254 bits under uniformity, not one bit.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: What replaces XOR parity collapse?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: Fp linear relations and nonlinear solution-set unions. SHA GF(2) ranks do not transfer.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: Do per-row probabilities multiply?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: Only conditional probabilities on the actual propagated population. Local DDT maxima and sampled marginals are not independent coins.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: Can internal states be chosen freely?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: No: p^2 legal points in p^3 internal states. Internal triple coordinates retain the 1/p legal membership constraint.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: What changes if we add more blocks?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: The proposed ConstantLength<2> contest domain has exactly one two-element block; adding blocks changes the target.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: Can round constants be changed?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: No. Prefixes retain deployed RF8/RP56 constants; constants disappear from additive differences but constrain actual states.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: Can periodic / spiral ideas transfer?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: Not literally as bit rotations. The exact partial-round Krylov/observability chart is the tested coordinate-system analogue.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: Can we mine the failed pairs?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: Exact collision/trash conservation tested in toy field. No native reduced-round collision population or correction family sampled.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: Can a cheap signature choose the better route?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: Eight preregistered-in-code input signatures vs LSB show no significant effect; meaningful conditional route ranking is still open.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: Does additional family size cut work?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: Not automatically. Selection/setup/yield/distinctness and conditional success must be counted together.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: What is the current score and leader?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: No verified live Poseidon leaderboard in the retrieved snapshot; PR is open and excludes registration/baselines.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: What is the generic reference?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: Output alphabet p, about 2^254; birthday scale sqrt(p), about 2^127. Not the strength of one or two rounds.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: Are field and CPU word operations the same?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: No. Proposed field arithmetic and measured CPU times are separate columns; no inherited SHA/BLAKE unit conversion.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: What is memory use?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: A canonical state is 96 bytes and 192 constants + MDS is 6432 bytes; actual Python objects/workbook overhead differs. No proposed search-memory score.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: How do we avoid local-only false gains?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: Always replay from canonical m0,m1 and fixed capacity through the requested endpoint; do not repair intermediate lanes independently.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: What lower bounds are established?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: Only scoped linear facts and quartic root upper bounds; no optimal collision-search lower bound.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: How should we calibrate solvers?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: Replay published vectors; local root tests match exhaustive p257; native reference uses two independent expressions; no solver campaign claimed.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: What is the native end-to-end success rate?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: Not measured for a collision generator. Diagnostic parity/avalanche checks cannot substitute for it.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: Does a reduced result break deployed Zcash?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: No such inference: deployed 64 rounds, protocol key/input roles and nullifier composition differ from freely chosen contest fields.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: Do all-round degrees prove hardness?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: No. 5^(r+1) is only a formal degree upper bound; coordinate changes already lower the r2 description to degree5.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: What was actually newly learned here?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: Exact affine first image, quintic coefficients, partial chart across54 windows, silent horizon, derivative trap, native local roots and toy conservation.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: What remains at bedrock?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: Verified local algebra and replay. Global multi-round legal fibre laws, every conditional relationship and useful generator costs remain open.

question_crosswalk.prior_question: How much of the grid is finished?
question_crosswalk.poseidon_answer: 64/64 structural cards;4096/4096 indexed cells;2080/2080 forward cells sampled at24 internal interventions each; no global necessity-completion percentage asserted.
